{{Quote|Welcome to the Galactic Moon Festival! What can I do for you friend? A costume perhaps? Or some trinkets courtesy of the benevolent Jabba the Hutt?|Z'ozpheratu, to a Galactic Moon Festival celebrant|<ref name="SWG:GMF" />}}
'''Z'ozpheratu''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-eyed [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he helped organize the [[Galactic Moon Festival]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] in the name of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] himself. During the Galactic Moon Festival he received the visitors of the planet and the tourists of other planets. He was well known for transform into skeletons, phantoms and [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizards]] celebrating that party in an "usual" way.<ref name="SWG:GMF" />
